name: KH1FM Dual Wield Prototype v2

runtime_scope.ground_and_air: ability-free Valor base rows; ground hop rows excluded
runtime_scope.idle: Valor standing battle idle over native idle slots only; game-frame clock
runtime_scope.casting_and_locomotion: native KH1; imported controller owns attacks only
runtime_scope.weapon: duplicate current KH1 weapon, no secondary selection or inventory claim
runtime_scope.appearance: native Sora model/textures/colours; custom idle and attack poses only
runtime_scope.contacts: both blades by default; offhand_only_test isolates left imported ground/air contacts
runtime_scope.trail: per-hand windows, same-tick posed left emitter, all-exit retirement; no enemy required
runtime_scope.pose: exact actor-instance identity, actor-anchored placement, complete world-space weapon snapshot

limitations: No local KH2 install: data import, native rendering, effects and air handoffs require runtime validation.
Optional upstream game-data tests did not exercise their real-data paths.
Windows DLL cross-compiled on Linux, not executed inside KH1 here.
Contact geometry originates in Valor data; different KH1 weapon lengths need gameplay verification.
Old offhand Lua/model assets and full combat overhaul must be disabled.
